|game_text=Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette it is immune to attrition <5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 force to move ship away (for free).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Captain Antilles]] (version 2 of 4). This version has no document image of its own, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of this text ([[:File:VB7-03-Captain_Antilles-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]). Versions in date order: [[Captain Antilles]] (original, release sheet of 3 June 2011); '''this page''' (PC-E1, PC website card list, by 21 July 2012); [[Captain Antilles (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, Players Committee card image, uploaded 25 February 2013, the same words as the original); [[Captain Antilles (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3, Master List of 27 April 2013, the same words as the original, the current text).
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Antilles]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “[Pilot] 2, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette, it is immune to attrition < 5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 Force to move starship he pilots away (for free).”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 5, slip 23 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The game text above writes the pilot icon “2, 3: any corvette” out as “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots (3 if any corvette)”. The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the original text again; under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Captain Antilles (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=5, page 5. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints no slip number.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) dropped the comma after “corvette”, printed “<5” and “force”, and changed “move starship he pilots away” to “move ship away”: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette it is immune to attrition <5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 force to move ship away (for free).”<ref name="cl-1273_23-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> (“Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots” is the card list's wording of the pilot icon.) The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Captain Antilles (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-captainantilles-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Captain Antilles]]) again, word for word: “[Pilot] 2, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette, it is immune to attrition < 5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 Force to move starship he pilots away (for free).” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual7-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual7-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034736/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual7-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Captain Antilles (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 5)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Captain Antilles]]) again, word for word: “[Pilot] 2, 3: any corvette. While piloting a corvette, it is immune to attrition < 5 and, once per turn, may peek at a card in opponent's hand. Once per game, during battle (unless Vader here) may use 2 Force to move starship he pilots away (for free).” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-23-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number, like the release-sheet slip and the PC card image.
